FAQ

Questions creators ask before exporting

What are word-by-word captions?

They are captions where individual words or short phrases can be highlighted in sync with speech.

Can I fix timing mistakes?

Yes. The subtitle timing editor exists so captions can be corrected before export.

Are word-by-word captions good for podcasts?

They are often useful for podcast clips and talking-head videos when readability stays clear.
